_comment: sha256 of every version of a vendorable plugin artifact dk has ever shipped, keyed by the plugin-relative path. dk-converge.mjs uses this to answer one question: 'is this copy in a project something I shipped, or something I have never seen?' A copy matching an entry here is a plugin artifact — safe to remove or refresh mechanically. A copy matching nothing here is a migration with consequences: dk-converge stops and surfaces it rather than overwriting it. The CURRENT version is never listed; dk-converge hashes its own live sibling files for that, so this file only has to grow when a release changes one of these artifacts.
_maintenance: On any release that changes one of these files, append the OUTGOING version's sha256 here before shipping the new one. plugins/dk/bin/tests/dk-converge.test.sh asserts the current shipped hashes are NOT present, which is what keeps this file honest about which side of the line each hash is on.
